description: Fail-closed ingestion worker degrades instead of killing the web process; PostgreSQL sessions carry an idle-in-transaction reclaim bound; the portfolio_granted authorization finally has a bounded, single-candidate reader.

batches.purpose: Stop a fail-closed worker from taking the site down, and stop an abandoned transaction from wedging every writer.
batches.acceptance: site returns 200 after the 60-90s startup backfills; `show idle_in_transaction_session_timeout` reports 10min on a new application session; no idle-in-transaction session older than 10 minutes survives

batches.purpose: Add the reader for stage='portfolio_granted' so one authorized candidate can run without global autonomy.
batches.acceptance: dry run reports status=admissible with backends within cpu/llm and max_gpu_hours=0; a grant outside those bounds is refused
